reasons.blood-dripping-frenzy-blue: The blood-debt-heavy hand can become replacement draws, while banishing six-power cards enables Levia and boosts an entire turn of Brute and Shadow attacks.
reasons.shadow-puppetry-red: Adds power and guaranteed go again to a key attack, with an optional on-hit banish that further supports Levia and the banish payoffs.
reasons.no-fear-red: Selectively banishes six-power cards to enable Levia and the deck's conditional attacks, then returns those cards to hand during the end phase.
reasons.beast-within-yellow: Bloodrush Bellow, Deadwood Rumbler, and Wrecker Romp can trigger its graveyard ability, generating banishes and eventually replacing it with a six-power card.
reasons.darkest-hour-red: Its alternative payment can place a six-power card atop the deck for an attack-triggered banish while giving that Shadow attack a substantial power boost.
reasons.visit-the-boneyard-blue: Instantly places a known six-power graveyard card atop the deck so the next top-deck banish can enable Levia and multiple attack payoffs.
reasons.blasmophets-boon-blue: With a Blasmophet established, its explicitly defined six power supports Bloodrush Bellow, Levia, and the graveyard-banish attacks.
reasons.deep-rooted-evil-yellow: The deck's six-power banish condition unlocks an additional Brute attack from banishment rather than leaving that banished card inaccessible.
reasons.ebon-fold: Provides a controlled hand banish that can enable Levia with a six-power card and replace a banished Shadow card with a draw.
reasons.goremass-summoning-blue: Turns the deck's central six-power banish condition into a Blasmophet without requiring Beckoning Hunger to hit, enabling Consuming Lash's attack mode.
